title: Disjointness of tribe coordinate blocks
statement: Let $w,s$ be natural numbers, let $T$ be a finite subset of the pairs $(i,o)$ with $i	ext{ in }	ext{Fin}(s)$ and $o	ext{ in }	ext{Fin}(w)$, and let $i,j	ext{ in }	ext{Fin}(s)$ be distinct. For each coordinate $i$, take the offsets $o$ for which $(i,o)$ belongs to $T$, and embed them into the $i$th coordinate block of $	ext{Fin}(s w)$. The resulting subsets for $i$ and $j$ are disjoint.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite subset of $	ext{Fin}(s w)$
